The '''Eriadu prototype armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] produced on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] era. It provided good protection and allowed a lot of movement to the wearer. However, Eriadu did not pursue general production of the armor pending further tests, and by the time of the [[Rise of the Empire era]], it was not a common sight to the general public. The armor was more easily upgradeable than most armor and the redeemed [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his companions may have obtained a set of Eriadu prototype armor during their quest for the [[Star Map]]s and the [[Star Forge]]. It was similar in design to the [[Jedi Civil War]] era [[heavy combat suit]]s, [[Republic mod armor]]s, and [[Zabrak battle armor]]s except that the plating was blue rather than silver.

==Behind the scenes==
The Eriadu prototype armor was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' but it was removed from the final version of the game. As the armor was still present in the game files, it could be obtained using cheat codes.
